body:
Part of feature:f414f1311c67fe80. The **Migration** menu tab and page become **Workspace**, at `/workspace`.

- **Shell** (`solace-cli/frontend`): the menu reads Board, Workspace, Contracts, Strategy, Settings. `/workspace` shows `<solace-migration>`, and `/migrate` is replaced in the history by `/workspace`. Update the README's page table and menu line.
- **Server** (`board.rs`, the page match beside `/migrate`): serve the shell at `/workspace` as well as `/migrate`. The JSON API stays at `/migration`; `/projects` stays the projects API and can't be a page address.
- **Migration component** (`solace-cli/migration`): the page heading reads **Workspace**, and migration becomes a section of the page (heading such as "Bring in an existing project"). The package and the `solace-migration` tag keep their names.
- **Wording:** the board's "Migration page" link in `solace_board.projects_view` points to `/workspace` and says "Workspace page". The guide (`board/guide.html`, "open Migration in the menu bar"), the root README, Spec 15 and Spec 17 name the Workspace page. Messages in `main.rs`/`workspace.rs` that say "choose Migrate this project" still match the button's label.
- Record the rename and the `/workspace` address (why not `/projects`) as a decision in `DECISIONS.md`.

**Tests:** frontend tests: the menu label, `/workspace` routing and the `/migrate` redirect. The migration component test (`test/component.html`) checks the new heading. `board_acceptance.py`'s page list includes `/workspace`.
title: workspace: rename Migration page
